stats.notes: CDS C1 (Fall 2025): 6,790 applied, 6,213 admitted (91%); international 308 applied, 288 admitted (94%), 26 enrolled. 14 applicants of unknown residency (all admitted) are in the totals only. Enrolled 2,359 is the C1 first-time first-year count (full- and part-time); CDS B1/B2 shows 2,436 degree-seeking first-time first-years, so treat enrollment as approximate. 96% of enrolled first-years submitted ACT scores (1,712); SAT scores are not reported in C9. No waitlist, no early decision/action; CDS C14 gives a Jan. 15 priority date and Aug. 1 closing date. Undergraduate enrollment is the B1 total (14,294 incl. non-degree-seeking; 9,795 degree-seeking); nonresidents 266 (B2).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2026): Southeastern uses SAT/ACT in admission decisions; the 'SAT or ACT' and 'ACT only' rows are checked 'Recommended' and 'SAT only' is 'Not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS G1 first-year figures for 2025-2026 (the 2026-27 figures are not yet published): in-state tuition $5,777, nonresident alien tuition $18,255 ($897 per credit hour), required fees $3,266, on-campus food and housing $10,200. CDS H6 (2024-25): 229 degree-seeking nonresident aliens received institutional non-need-based aid (average $15,939, total $3,649,929).
